Dependable finish or not, many thanks for your thoughts. We understand that your complaint concerns the handling of a companion animal during travel and the gap between the care you expected and the service you experienced. Your message has been reviewed with care, and we regret that the journey left you dissatisfied. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk expects every case to be handled with patient attention, clear handover, and steady communication from booking through arrival.

Please be assured that our staff are trained to support animals calmly and to follow a stepwise review whenever a concern is raised. This approach allows us to examine what occurred, confirm whether the correct procedures were followed, and identify where service may have fallen short. We also share practical instructions with crews so that animal travel arrangements are handled consistently, with the welfare of the pet kept in clear focus.

If your concern involved delay, unfamiliar handling, or a lack of useful updates, that is not the standard we seek to maintain. In matters of this kind, the proper response is careful review, prompt internal follow-up, and respectful communication with the traveler. We take that responsibility seriously. When a complaint shows that a traveler felt unsupported, we treat it as an important service issue rather than a routine remark.

Please note that the Companion Animal Travel Desk records each report and passes it through the appropriate review path. Where needed, the concern is escalated in a calm and orderly manner so that the facts can be checked by the relevant team. This process helps us protect animal welfare and improve the guidance given to crews and ground staff.

We value the opportunity to address your concerns and to restore confidence in Aurelia Skyways. Thank you for bringing the matter to our attention, and please accept our assurance that your feedback will inform further service review and staff reinforcement.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
